title: Jamaican Maple Fritters
description: Sweet and spicy Jamaican-inspired fritters with a hint of maple syrup, perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, jerk seasoning, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together milk and maple syrup.
4. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
5. Fold in crushed Jolly Rancher candies.
6. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
7. Fry fritters for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Drain fritters on paper towels and serve warm.
